subject: Celestis AI — request for safety buffer & GPU SKU mix ahead of signature
messages:
From: Marta Novak <marta@celestis.ai>

Cc: Jason Li <jason@celestis.ai>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Quick ask: can Redwood provision a small safety buffer pre-signature?

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers looked promising and the team is excited to move forward. We have a final internal sign-off meeting scheduled for Nov 10, and procurement typically takes another 5–7 business days after that. Given the timelines, would Redwood be willing to provision a modest safety buffer of dedicated capacity for the first 30 days post-signature?

High-level ask: 8 A100-equivalent slots with a 20% burst lane for short peaks. We understand this would be a temporary, conditional commitment (billing starts on signature) — we're asking so we can avoid dropped POCs if usage spikes during our ramp.

Happy to sign whatever conditional paperwork you need or provide a short MOU. Would you prefer we loop procurement now or wait until we reach signature?

Appreciate the help,
Marta
Marta Novak
Head of Platform
Celestis AI

Team — forwarding Celestis' note. TL;DR: they want a 30-day pre-commit safety buffer (8 A100-equivalent + 20% burst) to cover ramp spikes during go-live. They can sign an MOU; billing begins on contract signature.

Ask to infra: can we put a short-term safety buffer on the books for this account with clear rollback rules (no billing before signature; automatic release if they miss signature by X days)? We're late-stage here and small — would prefer an operational hold vs. long-running reserve.

Laura — FYI for commercial: what guardrails would you want on this (max days, notification cadence, escalation process if we exceed safety buffer)?

Dev — can you check SKU mix options (A100 vs A800-like variants, quantization profiles) and whether we can offer a 20% burst lane without impacting committed pools? If there's a material cost delta, flag it so I can push a minor credit.

I'll loop in Finance if we need a short MOU template. Need an internal answer by EoD Wed so I can respond before their Nov 10 sign-off.

Thanks,

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: can Redwood provision a small safety buffer pre-signature?

Rishi / Laura — dug into capacity and SKU tradeoffs. Summary below; attaching a short recommendation PDF and an XLS with slot math.

Key constraints and recommendation:
- Availability: We can set aside an 8-slot safety buffer for 30 days starting on an agreed hold-date. Slots = A100-equivalent vram.
- Burst lane: Implementable via a temporary burst pool mapped to non-committed spare capacity (20% burst). This is best-effort and preemptible if we need to reassign to higher-priority enterprise commitments.
- SKU mix: Recommend 6 x A100-class + 2 x A800-class for cost balance. A800s handle quantized FP16/INT8 inference more cost-effectively for their model family.
- Quantization profile: Recommend medium-precision INT8 for their workloads (saves ~35% token cost with negligible quality delta in our evals).
- Billing / guardrails: No billing until signature. Technical hold created in internal scheduler with tags: celestis_safetybuffer_RDW-2026-3847. Auto-release if not signed by 45 days after hold-date; 7-day notice email prior to release. Any usage beyond buffer defaults to on-demand pricing; option to convert to committed during signature.

Operational impact: Minimal if we limit hold to 30 days and mark burst as preemptible. High-risk window is week 2–4 if other enterprise outages occur.

Attachments: sku_mix_recommendation.pdf, capacity_plan_v3.xlsx

Let me know if you want me to mark the hold-date as their requested Nov 10 or set a tentative Nov 6 hold to give them runway.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infra Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Quick ask: can Redwood provision a small safety buffer pre-signature?

Marta / Jason — thanks for the clarity and for being flexible. We can accommodate a 30-day safety buffer with the following terms: 

1) Scope: 8 A100-equivalent slots (6 A100-class + 2 A800-class), with a 20% preemptible burst lane.
2) Billing: billing starts on signature; no fees before signature.
3) Hold-date: we will provision the hold on Nov 10 (your sign-off date) at midnight PT to give your team runway; if you want earlier provisioning, tell us your preferred hold-date and we'll evaluate.
4) Auto-release policy: if contract signature is not completed within 45 days of the hold-date, we will release the buffer; we will send a 7-day prior notice.
5) Conversion: any usage that exceeds the buffer can be converted to a committed pool during signature or billed at on-demand rates.

I'll have legal draft a short MOU that captures the above and a one-page ops runbook for the release/escalation path. Laura — please confirm commercial guardrails (maximum credit exposure if they exceed buffer before signature). Dev — please schedule the hold in the scheduler and tag it with celestis_safetybuffer_RDW-2026-3847; set the auto-release timer.

Marta — if that matches your expectations, we'll send the MOU and the ops runbook by EoD Thu so you can include it in your Nov 10 package. Appreciate the quick turnaround — excited to get Celestis onboarded.

Best,
Rishi
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
